en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a small European town nestled in a hilly landscape. A gently curving road lined with two- and three-story houses runs through the scene, with iron railings in the foreground and telegraph poles along the street. People are walking in the distance. At the top of the image, printed caption text reads "Glashütte i. Sa. — Obere Hauptstraße".
